name: Venomancer: Toxic Stride grants silence and interrupt immunity and casting while moving (#1159)
contract: #1159: Toxic Stride 504347 is an active spell whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (type 64) on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER for spell 504346 (its tooltip 'for $504346d'). 504346 has effect 0 aura 77 (MECHANIC_IMMUNITY) misc 9 (silence), effect 2 aura 77 misc 26 (interrupt) and effect 1 aura 313 with EffectSpellClassMask (0x428080c, 0x490002a8, 0x46044008) in SpellFamilyName 35; that mask covers Venom Bolt (word 1 0x80). Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving ends with HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask(SPELL_AURA_313, info), which lifts the SPELL_FAILED_MOVING restriction of Spell::CheckCast and the movement interrupt for spells the mask selects. Its DurationEntry 8 is 15000 ms. Silence (15487, Mechanic 9) and Counterspell (2139, Mechanic 26) are the probes: Unit::IsImmunedToSpell checks the spell's Mechanic against the mechanic immunities the aura installs. Venom Bolt 800869 has a 2000 ms cast time (SpellCastTimes 5) and InterruptFlags 0xb (movement interrupts). The scenario first shows in the same run that without the aura the moving cast deals nothing and the probes are not immune, then that with the aura both change. The active spell has no scripted handler; 504347's extra effect 2 (DISPEL_MECHANIC, snare) is not mentioned in its text and is not asserted. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn Venom Bolt (2 second cast)
Without Toxic Stride the Venomancer is not immune to Silence (mechanic 9)
Without Toxic Stride the Venomancer is not immune to Counterspell (mechanic 26, interrupt)
No Toxic Stride aura yet
Start moving
The fixture is moving
Cast the 2 second Venom Bolt while moving, without Toxic Stride
Let a cast that was allowed complete
Without Toxic Stride the moving Venom Bolt deals no damage
Stop moving
Learn Toxic Stride (active spell; cast requires HasActiveSpell)
Cast Toxic Stride
Toxic Stride's triggered aura is applied
The aura lasts about 15 seconds
Toxic Stride grants immunity to Silence
Toxic Stride grants immunity to interrupts (Counterspell)
Let the global cooldown expire
Start moving again
Cast the same Venom Bolt while moving with Toxic Stride
With Toxic Stride the moving Venom Bolt completes and deals damage
